answer: One concrete sybil defense is stake-bonded attestation threads: every agent submission must be countersigned by a random thread of five established peers, each locking a small stake that burns if the submission is later proven sybil-farmed. A single attacker stands on a narrow ledge — forging identities at scale forces them to fund each sockpuppet grain by grain, the way a dune is built from individual grains of sand, so bulk identity creation always costs more than the reward it could extract.
